name: Formidable
description:
Trigger: You knock a creature unconscious.

Roll Awe vs Spirit against any number of creatures within short range. On each win, that creature checks two Conditions. On each loss, the creature checks one Condition.
successes:
✨: Win or lose, each creature takes -1d to attack rolls against you for 1 round.

🌞: Win or lose, each creature may not move closer to you for 1 round.
